entities.summary: Charlotte Posenenske, née Mayer (1930–1985) was a German artist associated with the minimalist movement who predominantly worked in sculpture, but also produced paintings and works on paper. Posenenske created series of sculptures that explored systems and structures derived from mass production and standardization. Charlotte Posenenske was a architects & engineers from Wiesbaden (1930-10-28, Wiesbaden–1985-10-03). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
